newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-MCNULTY SHARES WILD COAST CHALLENGE LEAD.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-MCNULTY SHARES WILD COAST CHALLENGE LEAD.

text.p: Mark McNulty continued his recent run of impressive form with a four-under-par 66 to share the first round lead in the Wild Coast Challenge on Thursday.
The 43-year-old Zimbabwean, who won last week's South African Masters, picked up four birdies in a faultless back nine.
"I putted well, hit the ball well and didn't make a mistake," McNulty said.
He shares the lead with South Africans Desvonde Botes, Nic Henning and Clinton Whitelaw.
